notes.claims: The upper abandoned construction describes a coproduct of intersections of open pieces and classes of an equivalence relation. No proof of this assertion was performed; the relation-order convention is not established by this page alone.
notes.mathematical_reading_decisions: Notation and the adjacent clear glyphs directed attention to ambiguous i/j, I/J, ψ/Y, and bar shapes. Expected formulas were not substituted for visible j, j′, J, or the high prime on the first A_i.
notes.author_doubts: No explicit handwritten question mark or authorial doubt phrase is visible on this leaf. Editorial unsure marks should not be attributed to the author.
author_slips_preserved: I, J ens. ord. is written beside a diagram whose right target is I′.
The image target is I×J, while the set comprehension uses I×I′.
The comprehension begins (i,j′), while the next line uses j=(i,i′).
The first lower definition visibly writes A_i′; the boxed equality uses A_i without that prime.
The second lower definition uses j as subscript and cutoff index; H’s i′ is not the visible letter.
notes.cancellation: Four long oblique strokes are visible, not the three stated in H’s editorial note. Only Proposition is locally struck in the opening sentence; C’s blanket deletion of Soient ... L. is unsupported.
notes.paper: Pale vertical structures in the lower right are paper/bleed-through, not additional manuscript text. No textual watermark has been transcribed.
notes.method: Only the assigned scan was inspected. No OCR, text-recognition tool, external research, or TeX compilation was used. All comparisons are against the supplied witnesses and manual inspection of the ink.
notes.remaining_limitation: The heavily overdrawn H-like cluster, A/B chronology, tiny old subscripts, and the coproduct inner bar remain explicit doubts for the main and blind readers.
